description: This file defines an interface class 'IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper' for managing protection metadata in a GStreamer buffer within the 'firebolt::rialto::server' namespace. It declares virtual methods for adding, retrieving, and removing protection metadata, and includes licensing information and include guards.

classes.name: IGstProtectionMetadataWrapper
classes.description: An interface class for handling protection metadata in GStreamer buffers, providing methods to add, retrieve, and remove protection metadata.

methods.name: addProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Adds protection metadata to a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: getProtectionMetadataData
methods.description: Retrieves protection metadata data from a GStreamer buffer.

methods.name: removeProtectionMetadata
methods.description: Removes protection metadata from a GStreamer buffer.
